heading: TTL term: log and linearity both eliminated
text:
### TTL term: log and linearity both eliminated [LDTL.7.3]

```
# With dynamic_ttl (heap):
  c_ttl × expired_max × log₂(N_ttl)        ← log factor, N_max-proportional

# Without dynamic_ttl (FIFO queue):
  c_ttl × (max_expired_per_tick × log₂(n_ttl_schemas) + n_ttl_schemas)   ← constant
```

The heap term has two problems: a log factor in N_ttl and proportionality
to `expired_max` which itself grows with N_max.  The FIFO term replaces
both with a single constant derived from schema TTL durations, tick
interval and the number of TTL schemas; its log factor is in that number,
which is fixed at compile time ([LDTL.6.1]).
